description: Group the calls of one load-test RUN that did not pass into named failure patterns, by the run's `id` (from listLoadTestRuns). Returns totalCalls, failedCalls, unclassified (failed calls no rule matched), late starts, and `patterns`, most calls first: each with a label, owner (platform, carrier, system-under-test, test-definition or unknown: who has to fix it), a one-sentence description, count, share of failed calls, calls per lane, first and last seen and up to five example call ids; plus a timeline of failures and calls in flight. Takes optional `scope`: group (default, every lane started with the run) or lane (this run only). Use when: the user asks why a load test failed or whose problem the failures are. Read an example call with getRunResults. Read-only. Needs testing:read.

id.description: Load-test RUN identifier (the runId, NOT the config ID).

scope.description: `group` (default): every lane started with this run. `lane`: this run only.

name: getLoadTestFailurePatterns

outputSchema.description: A load-test run's failures by pattern (wiki designs/load-test-failure-patterns §06a).

groupId.description: The group the run was started in; null for a one-config run.

lateStarts.description: Calls whose system under test first spoke later than the late-answer threshold.

patterns.description: One entry per pattern with at least one call, most calls first.

byLane.description: Calls per lane, by lane run id.

description.description: The pattern's rule in one plain sentence.

examples.description: Up to five call ids, earliest first.

firstSeen.description: Start time of the earliest call in the pattern.

lastSeen.description: Start time of the latest call in the pattern.

counts.description: Failed calls started in the bucket, per pattern id.

inFlight.description: Calls in progress at any point in the bucket.

title: Get Load Test Failure Patterns
